设计意图： The primary mechanism preserves the payoff-first parent’s drawdown-conditioned downside-tail fragility signal. A single bounded modifier from the overnight-repricing parent attenuates the fragility penalty when recent price discovery is led by overnight repricing rather than intraday surrender, since that information-led return source can indicate better shock absorption than comparable intraday-l

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 previous_close：close.shift(1)
  2. 计算 downside_tail：(previous_close - low).clip(lower=0.0) / previous_close
  3. 计算 upside_tail：(high - previous_close).clip(lower=0.0) / previous_close
  4. 计算 downside_energy：downside_tail.pow(2).滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).sum()
  5. 计算 upside_energy：upside_tail.pow(2).滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).sum()
  6. 计算 tail_asymmetry：downside_energy / (downside_energy + upside_energy)
  7. 计算 drawdown：1.0 - close / close.滚动窗口(60, min_periods=60).max()
  8. 计算 phase_activity：(overnight_ret.abs() + intraday_ret.abs()).滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).sum()
  9. 计算 overnight_phase：((overnight_ret - intraday_ret).滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).sum() / phase_activity).clip(lower=-1.0, upper=1.0)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_tail_fragility_overnight_buffer(df): """Penalizes drawdown tail fragility, with a bounded buffer ">class="kw">for overnight-led repricing.""" df_copy = df.copy() previous_close = df_copy["close"].shift(1) downside_tail = (previous_close - df_copy["low"]).clip(lower=0.0) / previous_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) upside_tail = (df_copy["high"] - previous_close).clip(lower=0.0) / previous_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) downside_energy = downside_tail.pow(2).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum() upside_energy = upside_tail.pow(2).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum() tail_asymmetry = downside_energy / (downside_energy + upside_energy).replace(0.0, np.nan) drawdown = 1.0 - df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].rolling(60, min_periods=60).max().replace(0.0, np.nan) overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"]) phase_activity = (overnight_ret.abs() + intraday_ret.abs()).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum().replace(0.0, np.nan) overnight_phase = ((overnight_ret - intraday_ret).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum() / phase_activity).clip(lower=-1.0, upper=1.0) df_copy["factor_tail_fragility_overnight_buffer"] = -tail_asymmetry * drawdown * (1.0 - 0.35 * overnight_phase) "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_tail_fragility_overnight_buffer"]
